payload.reason: The evidence provides clear information on how IPA systems label data after interacting with users, specifically through the accumulation of structured and labeled dialogues.

claims.text: IPA systems label data by accumulating structured and labeled dialogues during user interactions, which allows for further training of dialogue components.
The system automatically labels user inputs with corresponding next actions and dialogue IDs without requiring additional post-labeling.
Entities from user queries are extracted and standardized to facilitate the training of a domain-specific Named Entity Recognition (NER) unit.
